findings.title: Cleanup batches log at Error level, including full ID lists, on every iteration
findings.description: The new `batchWork` closures call `r.log.Error(...)` twice per batch in the time-based branch, twice in the count-based branch, and twice in `CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags`. Routine successful cleanup is reported at Error severity. Error-level logs also trigger alerting in many setups. Each log line includes the full `ids` slice, which can hold up to `AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize` entries (32767 in the new test). Those entries repeat on every batch of every cycle. The `"err", err` field is also always nil at the first log call, so it adds no information there. These look like leftover debugging statements. They should be Debug-level, or reduced to counts without IDs.

findings.title: Cleanup ticker interval changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute with no accompanying change
findings.description: `time.NewTicker(time.Minute * 1)` replaces the previous 10-minute interval. The diff does not explain this change, and it is unrelated to the annotation work. It increases how often `cleanUpTmpFiles` and the other cleanup jobs run. If the change is intentional, it should be stated in the commit or PR. If not, it should be reverted.

findings.title: `strings` package use in `deleteByIDs` could not be confirmed against the file's imports
findings.description: `deleteByIDs` calls `strings.Repeat`. The import hunk for `xorm_store.go` only adds the `migrator` package, so `strings` must already be imported. I could not open the file to confirm this. If it is not imported, the package will not compile.
